description: Active cPanel session inventory for the selected account.

notes.text: Supplied strings retain case, punctuation and exact bytes and are encoded once. Optional null omits; empty strings remain supplied. No local locale, host, IP, password or name normalization or extra enum/range validation. One request only; no implicit lookup, login, redirect, retry, polling, cleanup or rollback. Live follow-up whm-api-client-8x0.2.69 remains OPEN.

Available from cPanel 138. Read-only inventory despite no x-readonly extension. Lists current session first, then most recently active; server order is retained. Generic sorting can replace source order, but this typed no-parameter method adds no generic controls or client sorting. Empty can mean no unexpired sessions or an unreadable session store. Demo/shared accounts cannot call it.

ip_address may be empty and session addresses are private. Native integer timestamps and strict integer 0|1 flags remain unchanged. is_possessed indicates reseller/root acting on behalf of user; tfa_verified describes only the returned session. No inference about current token authentication, revocation capabilities or session identifiers from IP/time.

evidence.note: Selected formal GET variant and ordinary Flag outcome; no response or requiredness correction. Read-only inventory retains effective GET.
